messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: type-inference & vectorized models committed
parts:
I was so excited about having Stan mostly done,
that I forgot to send this message on Saturday!

I just committed all the type inference code
and along the way cleaned up a lot of the parser
code naming conventions and organization.

There are parsability tests in place for all the
existing BUGS models.

I changed all the models that involved multivariate
parameters to be declared with the appropriate
types (that's why you were having trouble compiling,
Jiqiang -- you got close trying to make some things
matrices -- for the doc, Matrix<T,Dyn,Dyn> is
a matrix, Matrix<T,Dyn,1> is a column vector and
Matrix<T,1,Dyn> is a row vector. They all have
their own declarations.

- Bob
